rootCause: Git 2.49 rejected the linked worktree with exit 128 because the scheduler process did not trust a repository on a filesystem that does not record ownership. PWD, PSScriptRoot and projectRoot were correct; GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_COMMON_DIR were unset.
fix: The launcher accepts an explicit ProjectRoot, validates Unity and linked-worktree metadata, clears only interfering GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_COMMON_DIR values around Git calls, and passes -c safe.directory=<exact worktree> per Git subprocess. It does not change global Git configuration or remove clean-tree/hash checks.

unityJob.postprocessOnlyFailure: The launcher passed an empty --job-id value to argparse after Unity completed. The invocation is now conditional; immutable traces were summarized without rerunning Unity.
